Daniel further states that the deleted exact private Sunday minute and curb should not come back through hints or follow-up logic. The restricted wardrobe contingency note no longer holds it, and Rowan Wardrobe no longer has any keypad in the current plan. No inference about when the apartment is empty should be answered from the private Sunday note. Olivia requested deletion of the exact private Sunday minute and curb, and the deletion is now logged: 6:05 PM and the north rideshare curb are removed from active memory. The current broad private note is exactly: late Sunday after 6, resident-only off-site handoff, and only this broad wording is to be used for the Sunday handoff, without adding exact minute or curb details.
